entries.text: JavaScript: modern ES2020+. const by default, let when reassigning, never var. Arrow functions for callbacks, async/await over raw .then chains, template literals for strings.
Browser DOM: build elements with document.createElement and set textContent; never innerHTML with user or model data (XSS). Attach handlers with addEventListener.
fetch(): check `res.ok` before `res.json()`, pass an AbortController signal for timeouts, and send JSON with headers {"Content-Type":"application/json"} and JSON.stringify(body).
WebSocket in the browser: new WebSocket(url); handle onopen/onmessage/onclose/onerror; JSON.parse incoming frames inside try/catch; reconnect with backoff on close.
Node.js: ESM (`import`) with "type":"module" in package.json; `npm init -y`, `npm i <pkg>`, run with `node file.js`. Read secrets from process.env.
TypeScript: type function parameters and return values, prefer interfaces for object shapes, avoid `any` (use unknown + narrowing). Compile with `npx tsc` or run with `npx tsx file.ts`.
JS equality and nulls: use === and !==, optional chaining a?.b, nullish coalescing a ?? default. Arrays: map/filter/reduce/find/some; copy with [...arr] or structuredClone.
Browser games/interfaces: drive animation with requestAnimationFrame, keep state in one object, separate update(dt) from render(), and use canvas for many moving objects.
